slides.headline: OPENAI'S FIRST GADGET HAS SIX BUTTONS
slides.body: It's called Micro, built with keyboard company Work Louder. Six keys you set to run ChatGPT tasks, a voice button, and a dial. Reddit saw it first

slides.headline: A REVIEW CALLED IT 'ENGINEERED TO PISS ME OFF'

slides.headline: THE BOX COPIED APPLE'S PLAYBOOK
slides.body: Immaculate white box, clean minimal design: Apple's playbook, line for line. Apple sued them for trade theft weeks before this dropped. OpenAI's next move: a smart home device, built by ex-Apple engineers

slides.headline: $230 WASTED ON A GADGET NOBODY NEEDS
slides.body: Businesses dump cash on shiny AI tools that save zero hours. The AI that matters answers every customer in 30 seconds and runs 24/7. Your business doesn't need a $230 keyboard

slides.headline: OPENAI WON'T STOP AT A KEYBOARD
slides.body: A smart home device is next. Follow @yaffeai: we post every time AI companies make a move this big. Send this to the friend who buys every new gadget

caption:
Swipe to see OpenAI's new $230 AI keyboard and why the internet is roasting it 🔥

OpenAI's first hardware product, the Micro, is a $230 mini keyboard built with Work Louder. Six customizable ChatGPT keys, six command keys, a voice button, Bluetooth and USB. Aftermath reviewed it and said the price is impossible to justify. Reddit users trashed it. The packaging mirrors Apple's clean white aesthetic, and Apple sued OpenAI for trade theft weeks before the launch. OpenAI also has a smart home product in development, built by former Apple engineers.

OpenAI is building hardware while fighting Apple in court. The keyboard flopped with reviewers, but the playbook is clear: they want to own the physical space around you, not just the screen.
